sourceReview: v490 to v495 add_stake.rs, remove_stake.rs and move_stake.rs are identical. stake_utils changes only a comment.
GammaMinted removes spender; paid mint still reports native TAO and stake-funded mint still sets tao=0. Both exact reviewed layouts are accepted; other layouts fail.
BasketSwapped fields and native TAO routing remain unchanged; controls and work accounting do not change counted external legs.
Gamma emission mint remains internal alpha-to-alpha conversion, excluded from external TAO flow.
one_lock_bucket_per_hotkey migrates owner lock aggregates into hotkey maps. Read its flag at the pinned block and never double-count removed owner maps.
limitations: Three finalized live blocks plus source and regression tests. Contiguous trade history must recover before production totals are considered healthy. Unknown runtimes still stop.
